workflow_steps.title: Reproject borough boundaries to DEM CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the State College and Bellefonte borough polygons into the DEM coordinate reference system so zonal statistics can be computed.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the input borough boundary GeoPackage from its known source CRS EPSG:26918 to target CRS EPSG:3857. Preserve the polygon features and attributes.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate average elevation by borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the mean elevation from the DEM within each State College and Bellefonte borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Calculate mean zonal elevation statistics for each polygon in the reprojected borough boundary layer using the DEM raster. Retain the borough identifying attributes in the output summary table.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Raster Analysis Agent
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic raster reprojection, resampling, clipping, raster calculation, and zonal statistics. Consumes GeoTIFF rasters and GeoPackage polygon zones.

skills.name: Raster Geoprocessing
skills.description: Executes raster calculations, reprojections, grid resampling, spatial masking, and zonal aggregations.

constraints.spatial: Raster calculation requires compatible grid definitions and CRS. Zonal statistics require matching CRS between raster and GeoPackage zones.
other: Accepts GeoTIFF (.tif) rasters and GeoPackage (.gpkg) polygon zones.
